div.div: Every strategy ships the same JS, so interactive lands in roughly the same place. What you are choosing is how early something is READABLE — and whether that early HTML costs you a server per request (SSR), staleness (SSG), or added complexity (streaming).

a.text: Text is not SVG - cannot display
